data.title: Berkshire Park
data.about:
Berkshire Park by Nshama at Town Square Dubai offers a luxurious collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments and spacious 3-bedroom duplexes. Designed for professionals and families, these homes blend contemporary aesthetics with functionality. The development boasts sleek architecture with expansive windows, allowing residents to enjoy stunning views of the landscaped parks.

Nshama Berkshire Park apartments offer a harmonious living experience, combining modern comfort with the vibrant surroundings of Town Square Dubai. Its prime location ensures easy access to major roadways and amenities, making it ideal for urban living. Residents of Berkshire at Town Square Park Dubai enjoy world-class amenities, including jogging and cycling tracks, sports courts, a gym, and a swimming pool.

The Berkshire Park location provides access to retail and dining outlets and a variety of social and recreational activities. The thoughtfully designed floor plans, filled with natural light, create inviting living spaces perfect for relaxation. With flexible payment plans, investing in Nshama Berkshire Park offers an excellent opportunity for those seeking modern living in a thriving community.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated in Town Square Dubai, Berkshire Park offers access to major roads like Al Qudra and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed, connecting to critical spots like Downtown Dubai, Marina, and Expo 2020.
  • World-Class Amenities: For an active lifestyle, enjoy basketball and tennis courts, a swimming pool, a gym, cycling and jogging tracks, and landscaped parks.
  • Modern Design & Architecture: Sleek design with expansive windows and brick cladding, providing beautiful views and a luxurious living experience.
  • Variety of Living Spaces: This complex offers 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, ranging from 633.56 to 2187.33 sq. ft., suited for professionals and families.
  • Thriving Community: Part of the growing Town Square community, with retail, cafes, and recreational activities, is ideal for urban living.
  • Proximity to Attractions: Minutes from top attractions like Dubai Miracle Garden, Plantation Equestrian & Polo Club, and The Dubai Mall.

location_tile.title: Experience Vibrant Living at Berkshire Park: Your Gateway to Modern Comfort and Unmatched Amenities!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Berkshire Park by Nshama at Town Square Dubai is ideally located within a vibrant and lush community. Its prime Berkshire Park location provides quick access to major highways like Al Qudra Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, connecting easily to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Expo 2020 site. Berkshire at Town Square Park Dubai offers a home and a lifestyle, with central parks, retail outlets, cafes, and entertainment all within walking distance, making it a perfect destination for modern living.

  • 10 Minutes to Plantation Equestrian and Polo Club
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 20 Minutes to Jebel Ali Racecourse
  • 20 Minutes to Expo 2020
  • 23 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
  • 25 Minutes to The Dubai Mall
